# WAS_CCA_op { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_op }

```python
WAS_CCA_op(
    n_modes=4,
    n_pca_modes=8,
    standardize=False,
    use_coslat=True,
    use_pca=True,
    dist_method='bestfit',
)
```



## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit) | Compute PB/PN/PA for the requested predictive distribution. |
| [calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric) | Non-parametric probabilities from the historical residual sample. |
| [compute_prob](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.compute_prob) | Compute hindcast tercile probabilities with guaranteed output order. |
| [plot_cca_results](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.plot_cca_results) | Plots the CCA modes and scores. |
| [weibull_shape_solver](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.weibull_shape_solver) | Compatibility wrapper for the historical public helper. |

### calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit }

```python
WAS_CCA_op.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit(
    best_guess,
    error_variance,
    T1,
    T2,
    dist_code,
    dof,
)
```

Compute PB/PN/PA for the requested predictive distribution.

### calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric }

```python
WAS_CCA_op.calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric(
    best_guess,
    error_samples,
    first_tercile,
    second_tercile,
)
```

Non-parametric probabilities from the historical residual sample.

### compute_prob { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.compute_prob }

```python
WAS_CCA_op.compute_prob(
    Predictant,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    hindcast_det,
    best_code_da=None,
    best_shape_da=None,
    best_loc_da=None,
    best_scale_da=None,
)
```

Compute hindcast tercile probabilities with guaranteed output order.

### plot_cca_results { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.plot_cca_results }

```python
WAS_CCA_op.plot_cca_results(
    X=None,
    Y=None,
    n_modes=None,
    clim_year_start=None,
    clim_year_end=None,
)
```

Plots the CCA modes and scores.

Parameters:
- X: Optional xarray DataArray for predictors. If provided, the model will be fitted using X and Y.
- Y: Optional xarray DataArray for predictands.
- n_modes: Number of modes to plot. If None, plots all modes.

### weibull_shape_solver { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_op.weibull_shape_solver }

```python
WAS_CCA_op.weibull_shape_solver(k, M, V)
```

Compatibility wrapper for the historical public helper.
